title: Tamil Nadu Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme – Special Coverage Pathways Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: CMCHIS includes specific beneficiary and treatment pathways administered under Tamil Nadu's current scheme rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the current CMCHIS beneficiary database, residence and notified household/income/category rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Tamil Nadu Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme – Special Coverage Pathways.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
